text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff... Almost... there!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As I stroll by the track early in the
morning, I see
K.S.Miracle running
earnestly.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A few hours later, right before classes
begin...
choice_data_list_en: (Working hard so early in the morning...)

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
We found it, we found it! You totes live
up to
your name, Miracle!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Man, I thought my fave water bottle was
a goner!
No way I would've found it
myself. Thanks for
helping a girl out,
you're a real one!

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text: It's nothing. I'm glad we found it.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Later on, around lunchtime...
choice_data_list: （友人の手伝いをしてるのかな）

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
And that's the last of them! Thanks for
helping me
put these posters up! Now
I'm more than ready to
enforce the rules
of No Tardiness Week!

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
No need to thank me. I'll make sure not
to be late
myself.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I owe you one! By the way, do you need
help with
anything? I'm pretty strong, so
if there's any
heavy lifting you need
done, let me know!

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Oh, thank you... But I'm fine. You're very
kind for
offering, Bamboo.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And then finally, at night...

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text: Huff... Huff... Huff...

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text: Oh. Good evening.
choice_data_list_en: (Isn't she pushing herself a bit too hard...?)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I tell her about how I saw her training in
the
morning, then running around all
day, helping
everyone out.
choice_data_list: そろそろ休んだ方がいいんじゃないか？
そろそろ休んだ方がいいんじゃない？
choice_data_list_en: Shouldn't you take a break soon?
Shouldn't you take a break soon?

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you saw all that? I'm sorry. I didn't
mean to
make you worry.

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
But it's nothing I can't handle. I'm doing
all of this
because I want to.

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text: Huh? Exhausted?
choice_data_list: でも、疲れは溜まってるはずだ
でも、疲れは溜まってるはずだよ
choice_data_list_en: Still, the fatigue must be piling up.
Still, the fatigue must be piling up.

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Haha, I'll be okay. I get my strength
from seeing
everyone's smiles.

text_block_list.name: K.S.Miracle
text_block_list.text: It's what lets me do my best!
